description: This script configures wireless interfaces, manages hostapd services, updates network configurations, and sets up web server and DHCP services for router modes, specifically handling bridge and wireless interface setup.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service on the 2.4GHz interface, killing existing processes and relaunching hostapd.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd_5G
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service on the 5GHz interface, reloading kernel modules and relaunching hostapd.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Kills existing hostapd processes and restarts the hostapd service on wlan0.
